content.title: Higher Treasury Yields Weigh on Home Builder Stocks

The iShares U.S. Home Construction ETF was 1.5% lower in mid-morning trading, on pace for its largest percentage decline since Jan. 7, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Builder stocks had been riding a wave of optimism spurred by a decline in mortgage rates earlier this month.
